screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.empty_hin: Read Recipe Pages (right click) to write them here. Torn pages show up in chests, on witches and with the wandering trader. Successful brews are written down too.
screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.heat_high: High: soul fire, a magma block or lava underneath.
screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.heat_low: Low: a lit campfire under the cauldron.
screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.heat_medi: Medium: fire or a soul campfire underneath.
screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.heat_none: No heat: light a fire under the cauldron.
screen.isekai_mahou.witch_book.stirs_tip: Stir with the Ritual Spoon after the ingredients. Stirring too much ruins it!
tooltip.isekai_mahou.bottled_curse.linge: Leaves a cursed mist on the ground
tooltip.isekai_mahou.revelation.lore: A sip of truth that cannot be forgotten.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ritual_spoon: Right click the Ritual Cauldron to stir.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ritual_spoon.warn: Count your stirs: stirring too much ruins the brew.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.witch_recipe_book: Right click to read your known recipes.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.witch_recipe_page.t: Right click to decipher an unknown recipe
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.curse_blight.d: Poison, hunger and withering, with a lingering mist. New moon only.
Weakens and exposes the enemies it hits.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.curse_hex.desc: Corrupts the flesh of enemies. Only on dark-moon nights.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.curse_mire.des: Traps enemies in mud and leaves them soaked.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_feather: Light as a feather: jump high and fall slowly. Prefers bright moons.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_mana.de: Restores mana and speeds up its regeneration. Prefers full moons.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_owl_eye: See in the dark and reveal the creatures around you.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_shadow_: Vanish into the shadows. Only completes under dark moons.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_stone_s: Skin hard as rock, heavy steps. Needs high heat.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_tides.d: Breathe and swim like the creatures of the sea.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.elixir_vitalit: Regenerates, shields and nourishes. Easy to brew over low heat.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_1.d: The first revelation: awakens Water and teaches the first Curses.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_2.d: Requires near-full moons and the essence of Water.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_3.d: New moon only, over high heat. Awakens Shadow.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_4: Revelation IV · Echo of the Abyss
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_4.d: Full moon only. Ingredients from the depths of the world.
witch_recipe.isekai_mahou.revelation_5.d: The final revelation: the Guardian Cores of Water and Shadow, under the new moon.
